correctness.rationale: Star Laplacian eigenvalues 0,1 (m-1),m+1 give explicit hub/leaf diagonal and positive offdiagonal expressions for Alexander r(hL). Scalar r minimum equals -(sqrt2-1)/2. Hub sign reduces to a quadratic with two positive roots for m>=5; leaf diagonal numerator quartic has coefficient signs (+,+,+,-,+), two positive roots by negative exact witness and Descartes. For m=5..9 exact sign at h=7/2 separates bands; for all m>=10 exact h=17/5 has two negative diagonals, so bands merge. Independent sign calculations m=5..13 show merger at 10; universal proof uses exact inequalities for every m.
